  <script>
    (() => {
      const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      const el = (tag, attrs = {}, parent = null) => {
        const node = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, tag);
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) {
          node.setAttribute(k, v);
        }
        if (parent) parent.appendChild(node);
        return node;
      };

      // Deterministic pseudo-random generator for clean, reproducible art
      let seed = 4219;
      const rand = () => {
        seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647;
        return (seed - 1) / 2147483646;
      };

      // ==========================================================
      // 1. PROCEDURAL SEAMLESS LANDSCAPE GENERATION
      // ==========================================================

      // Clouds
      const cloudsLayer = document.getElementById("cloudsLayer");
      const clouds = [];
      const cloudSpecs = [
        { x: 180, y: 125, scale: 1.05, speed: 6.5, opacity: 0.55 },
        { x: 560, y: 88, scale: 0.78, speed: 4.2, opacity: 0.45 },
        { x: 920, y: 142, scale: 0.92, speed: 5.5, opacity: 0.5 },
        { x: 1260, y: 105, scale: 0.68, speed: 3.8, opacity: 0.38 }
      ];
      cloudSpecs.forEach((c) => {
        const g = el("g", { filter: "url(#cloudBlur)", opacity: c.opacity }, cloudsLayer);
        el("path", {
          d: "M-110,16 C-110,4 -94,-4 -76,-2 C-66,-18 -40,-24 -20,-14 C-4,-28 28,-28 44,-12 C66,-16 88,-6 92,10 C106,10 116,18 112,24 L-108,24 C-114,24 -116,18 -110,16 Z",
          fill: "#fde2c6"
        }, g);
        el("path", {
          d: "M-92,18 C-70,12 60,12 94,18 L96,24 L-96,24 Z",
          fill: "#ebb09d",
          opacity: "0.55"
        }, g);
        clouds.push({ ...c, node: g });
      });

      // Helper for 2560px seamless periodic mountain ridge
      function buildSeamlessMountain(parent, baseLine, amp1, amp2, cragAmp, fill, highlightFill) {
        const tileGroup = el("g", {}, parent);
        const pts = [];
        const step = 32;
        for (let x = 0; x <= 1280; x += step) {
          const t = (x / 1280) * Math.PI * 2;
          const crag = Math.abs(Math.sin(3 * t + 0.4)) * cragAmp;
          const y = baseLine
            - Math.sin(t + 0.5) * amp1
            - Math.sin(2 * t - 0.8) * amp2
            - crag;
          pts.push([x, y]);
        }

        let d = `M 0 720 L 0 ${pts[0][1].toFixed(1)} `;
        for (let rep = 0; rep < 2; rep++) {
          const offsetX = rep * 1280;
          for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
            d += `L ${(pts[i][0] + offsetX).toFixed(1)} ${pts[i][1].toFixed(1)} `;
          }
        }
        d += "L 2560 720 Z";
        el("path", { d, fill }, tileGroup);

        // Subtle sunlit snow/ridge accents on peak crests
        if (highlightFill) {
          for (let rep = 0; rep < 2; rep++) {
            const offsetX = rep * 1280;
            for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
              if (pts[i][1] < pts[i - 1][1] && pts[i][1] < pts[i + 1][1]) {
                const px = pts[i][0] + offsetX;
                const py = pts[i][1];
                const nx = pts[i + 1][0] + offsetX;
                const ny = pts[i + 1][1];
                el("path", {
                  d: `M ${px.toFixed(1)} ${py.toFixed(1)} L ${nx.toFixed(1)} ${ny.toFixed(1)} L ${(px + 10).toFixed(1)} ${(py + 22).toFixed(1)} Z`,
                  fill: highlightFill,
                  opacity: "0.42"
                }, tileGroup);
              }
            }
          }
        }
        return tileGroup;
      }

      const mtnFarGroup = buildSeamlessMountain(
        document.getElementById("mtnFarLayer"),
        365, 38, 22, 48, "url(#mtnFarGrad)", "#fde4cf"
      );

      const mtnMidGroup = buildSeamlessMountain(
        document.getElementById("mtnMidLayer"),
        425, 22, 16, 22, "url(#mtnMidGrad)", "#e7be9a"
      );

      // Smooth rolling back pasture hill (2560px seamless)
      const hillBackLayer = document.getElementById("hillBackLayer");
      {
        let d = "M 0 720 ";
        for (let x = 0; x <= 2560; x += 40) {
          const t = (x / 1280) * Math.PI * 2;
          const y = 456 + Math.sin(t) * 14 + Math.cos(2 * t + 0.6) * 8;
          d += `L ${x} ${y.toFixed(1)} `;
        }
        d += "L 2560 720 Z";
        el("path", { d, fill: "url(#hillBackGrad)" }, hillBackLayer);
      }

      // Mid-ground golden ichu grass clumps (behind alpaca)
      const backGrassLayer = document.getElementById("backGrassLayer");
      const backTufts = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
        const x = rand() * 1400 - 60;
        const y = 500 + rand() * 44;
        const scale = 0.6 + rand() * 0.65;
        const g = el("g", {}, backGrassLayer);
        const color = rand() > 0.45 ? "#9ca05f" : "#7e8a4e";
        for (let b = -2; b <= 2; b++) {
          const tipX = b * 4.5 + (rand() - 0.5) * 4;
          const tipY = -14 - rand() * 12;
          el("path", {
            d: `M ${(b * 1.6).toFixed(1)},0 Q ${(b * 2.4).toFixed(1)},${(tipY * 0.55).toFixed(1)} ${tipX.toFixed(1)},${tipY.toFixed(1)}`,
            fill: "none",
            stroke: color,
            "stroke-width": (1.6 * scale).toFixed(2),
            "stroke-linecap": "round"
          }, g);
        }
        backTufts.push({ node: g, x, y, scale, phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2 });
      }

      // Ground trail pebbles & micro grass specks (LOCKED to exact foot speed!)
      const trailDetailsLayer = document.getElementById("trailDetailsLayer");
      const trailDetails = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
        const x = rand() * 1400 - 60;
        const y = 556 + rand() * 28;
        const g = el("g", {}, trailDetailsLayer);
        if (rand() > 0.35) {
          // Small sunlit pebble
          const rx = 2.2 + rand() * 3.8;
          const ry = 1.1 + rand() * 1.6;
          el("ellipse", {
            cx: 0, cy: 0,
            rx: rx.toFixed(1), ry: ry.toFixed(1),
            fill: rand() > 0.5 ? "#8b7454" : "#cbb38f",
            opacity: (0.45 + rand() * 0.35).toFixed(2)
          }, g);
        } else {
          // Tiny ground grass sprig
          el("path", {
            d: "M-2,0 Q-4,-6 -6,-9 M0,0 Q1,-7 4,-10",
            fill: "none",
            stroke: "#727f48",
            "stroke-width": "1.3",
            "stroke-linecap": "round",
            opacity: "0.7"
          }, g);
        }
        trailDetails.push({ node: g, x, y });
      }

      // Foreground swaying grass & wildflowers (in front of alpaca)
      const frontGrassLayer = document.getElementById("frontGrassLayer");
      const frontItems = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        const x = rand() * 1460 - 90;
        const y = 622 + rand() * 96;
        const scale = 0.8 + (y - 620) / 140;
        const g = el("g", {}, frontGrassLayer);
        const bladeColor = rand() > 0.4 ? "#364423" : "#49582f";
        const blades = 3 + Math.floor(rand() * 3);
        for (let b = 0; b < blades; b++) {
          const offset = (b - (blades - 1) / 2) * 4.5;
          const h = (26 + rand() * 28) * scale;
          const bend = (rand() - 0.35) * 18;
          el("path", {
            d: `M ${offset.toFixed(1)},0 Q ${(offset + bend * 0.4).toFixed(1)},${(-h * 0.55).toFixed(1)} ${(offset + bend).toFixed(1)},${(-h).toFixed(1)}`,
            fill: "none",
            stroke: bladeColor,
            "stroke-width": (2.2 * scale).toFixed(2),
            "stroke-linecap": "round"
          }, g);
        }

        // Occasional delicate wildflower
        if (rand() > 0.52) {
          const fx = (rand() - 0.5) * 14;
          const fy = -(28 + rand() * 22) * scale;
          el("path", {
            d: `M 0,0 Q ${(fx * 0.4).toFixed(1)},${(fy * 0.55).toFixed(1)} ${fx.toFixed(1)},${fy.toFixed(1)}`,
            fill: "none",
            stroke: "#576838",
            "stroke-width": (1.6 * scale).toFixed(2),
            "stroke-linecap": "round"
          }, g);
          const flowerPick = rand();
          const petalColor = flowerPick > 0.65 ? "#fff7e8" : flowerPick > 0.3 ? "#ffd97d" : "#f4a38c";
          const fg = el("g", { transform: `translate(${fx.toFixed(1)}, ${fy.toFixed(1)})` }, g);
          for (let p = 0; p < 5; p++) {
            const ang = (p / 5) * Math.PI * 2;
            el("circle", {
              cx: (Math.cos(ang) * 3.4 * scale).toFixed(2),
              cy: (Math.sin(ang) * 3.4 * scale).toFixed(2),
              r: (2.2 * scale).toFixed(2),
              fill: petalColor
            }, fg);
          }
          el("circle", { cx: 0, cy: 0, r: (1.9 * scale).toFixed(2), fill: "#e6a43e" }, fg);
        }
        frontItems.push({ node: g, x, y, phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2, swayAmp: 3 + rand() * 3.5 });
      }

      // Floating sunlit dust motes
      const motesLayer = document.getElementById("motesLayer");
      const motes = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
        const x = rand() * 1280;
        const y = 140 + rand() * 440;
        const r = 1.1 + rand() * 2.2;
        const circle = el("circle", {
          cx: 0, cy: 0, r: r.toFixed(2),
          fill: "#fff6d6"
        }, motesLayer);
        motes.push({
          node: circle,
          x, y,
          vx: -(8 + rand() * 14),
          vy: -(3 + rand() * 6),
          phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
          baseOp: 0.2 + rand() * 0.45
        });
      }

      // ==========================================================
      // 2. ALPACA GAIT, 2-BONE IK & ANIMATION LOOP
      // ==========================================================
      const groundShadow = document.getElementById("groundShadow");
      const torsoGroup = document.getElementById("torsoGroup");
      const tailGroup = document.getElementById("tailGroup");
      const neckGroup = document.getElementById("neckGroup");
      const headGroup = document.getElementById("headGroup");
      const earBack = document.getElementById("earBack");
      const earFront = document.getElementById("earFront");
      const blinkLid = document.getElementById("blinkLid");

      const bindLeg = (id) => {
        const root = document.getElementById(id);
        return {
          upper: root.querySelector(".upperLeg"),
          lower: root.querySelector(".lowerLeg"),
          hoof: root.querySelector(".hoof")
        };
      };

      const legs = [
        {
          dom: bindLeg("farHindLeg"),
          anchorX: -54, anchorY: 22,
          restX: -54, groundY: 160,
          L1: 76, L2: 78,
          dir: 1, // hock bends backward (-x)
          phaseOffset: 0.0
        },
        {
          dom: bindLeg("farFrontLeg"),
          anchorX: 54, anchorY: 24,
          restX: 54, groundY: 160,
          L1: 74, L2: 76,
          dir: -1, // carpus bends forward (+x)
          phaseOffset: 0.25
        },
        {
          dom: bindLeg("nearHindLeg"),
          anchorX: -50, anchorY: 26,
          restX: -50, groundY: 164,
          L1: 76, L2: 78,
          dir: 1,
          phaseOffset: 0.50
        },
        {
          dom: bindLeg("nearFrontLeg"),
          anchorX: 48, anchorY: 28,
          restX: 48, groundY: 164,
          L1: 74, L2: 76,
          dir: -1,
          phaseOffset: 0.75
        }
      ];

      // Walking parameters
      const freq = 0.84;          // full 4-beat stride cycles per second
      const strideHalf = 32;      // half of stride length in px
      const stanceRatio = 0.66;   // foot planted for 66% of cycle
      const swingRatio = 1 - stanceRatio;
      const liftHeight = 25;      // hoof lift arc height
      const groundSpeed = (2 * strideHalf / stanceRatio) * freq; // exact px/sec match!

      function solveLegIK(ax, ay, bx, by, L1, L2, dir) {
        const dx = bx - ax;
        const dy = by - ay;
        let d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        const maxD = L1 + L2 - 1.2;
        const minD = Math.abs(L1 - L2) + 1.2;
        if (d > maxD) d = maxD;
        if (d < minD) d = minD;

        const baseAngle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        const cosA = (L1 * L1 + d * d - L2 * L2) / (2 * L1 * d);
        const clampedCos = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosA));
        const angleA = Math.acos(clampedCos);

        const jointAngle = baseAngle + dir * angleA;
        const jx = ax + Math.cos(jointAngle) * L1;
        const jy = ay + Math.sin(jointAngle) * L1;

        const lowerAngle = Math.atan2(by - jy, bx - jx);
        const upperDeg = (jointAngle - Math.PI / 2) * (180 / Math.PI);
        const lowerDeg = (lowerAngle - Math.PI / 2) * (180 / Math.PI);

        return { jx, jy, upperDeg, lowerDeg };
      }

      let elapsed = 0;
      let lastTime = performance.now();
      let blinkTimer = 2.6;
      let blinkProgress = -1;

      function tick(now) {
        const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
        lastTime = now;
        elapsed += dt;

        const phase = (elapsed * freq) % 1;
        const tau = Math.PI * 2;

        // 1. Torso bob, gentle lateral sway & pitch
        const bodyBobY = Math.sin(2 * tau * phase - 0.35) * 3.8;
        const bodyBobX = Math.cos(2 * tau * phase) * 1.4;
        const bodyPitch = Math.sin(tau * phase + 0.3) * 1.15;

        torsoGroup.setAttribute(
          "transform",
          `translate(${bodyBobX.toFixed(2)}, ${bodyBobY.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${bodyPitch.toFixed(2)})`
        );

        // Shadow subtly responds to body bob
        const shadowScale = 1 - bodyBobY * 0.008;
        groundShadow.setAttribute(
          "transform",
          `translate(${(bodyBobX * 0.6).toFixed(2)}, 0) scale(${shadowScale.toFixed(3)}, 1)`
        );

        // 2. Secondary motion: Neck, Head, Ears, Tail
        const neckRot = Math.sin(tau * phase - 0.45) * 2.6 + Math.sin(2 * tau * phase - 0.9) * 1.1;
        const headRot = -neckRot * 0.68 + Math.sin(2 * tau * phase - 1.4) * 1.3;
        const earBackRot = 12 + Math.sin(2 * tau * phase - 1.8) * 2.8;
        const earFrontRot = -5 + Math.sin(2 * tau * phase - 2.0) * 3.1;
        const tailRot = Math.sin(tau * phase - 0.8) * 5.2 + Math.sin(2 * tau * phase - 1.2) * 2.2;

        neckGroup.setAttribute("transform", `translate(54, -14) rotate(${neckRot.toFixed(2)})`);
        headGroup.setAttribute("transform", `translate(46, -116) rotate(${headRot.toFixed(2)})`);
        earBack.setAttribute("transform", `translate(8, -16) rotate(${earBackRot.toFixed(2)})`);
        earFront.setAttribute("transform", `translate(-8, -14) rotate(${earFrontRot.toFixed(2)})`);
        tailGroup.setAttribute("transform", `translate(-85, -12) rotate(${tailRot.toFixed(2)})`);

        // 3. Natural occasional blink
        blinkTimer -= dt;
        if (blinkTimer <= 0 && blinkProgress < 0) {
          blinkProgress = 0;
          blinkTimer = 3.2 + ((Math.sin(elapsed * 7.3) + 1) * 1.4);
        }
        if (blinkProgress >= 0) {
          blinkProgress += dt / 0.16;
          if (blinkProgress >= 1) {
            blinkProgress = -1;
            blinkLid.setAttribute("opacity", "0");
          } else {
            const bVal = Math.sin(blinkProgress * Math.PI);
            blinkLid.setAttribute("opacity", bVal > 0.35 ? "1" : "0");
          }
        }

        // 4. Four-leg IK update
        const pitchRad = (bodyPitch * Math.PI) / 180;
        const cosP = Math.cos(pitchRad);
        const sinP = Math.sin(pitchRad);

        for (let i = 0; i < legs.length; i++) {
          const leg = legs[i];
          const p = (phase + leg.phaseOffset) % 1;

          let footX, footY, hoofDeg;
          if (p < stanceRatio) {
            // Stance: locked on ground, moving backward at exact groundSpeed
            const s = p / stanceRatio;
            footX = leg.restX + strideHalf - s * (2 * strideHalf);
            footY = leg.groundY;
            hoofDeg = 0;
          } else {
            // Swing: lifts in smooth parabolic arc and swings forward
            const u = (p - stanceRatio) / swingRatio;
            const easeX = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * u);
            footX = leg.restX - strideHalf + easeX * (2 * strideHalf);
            const lift = Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.pow(u, 0.86));
            footY = leg.groundY - liftHeight * lift;
            // Toe dips gently at push-off, levels before landing
            hoofDeg = Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 1.35) * 14 * (1 - u * 0.45);
          }

          // Transform hip/shoulder anchor with torso bob & pitch
          const ax = bodyBobX + leg.anchorX * cosP - leg.anchorY * sinP;
          const ay = bodyBobY + leg.anchorX * sinP + leg.anchorY * cosP;

          const { jx, jy, upperDeg, lowerDeg } = solveLegIK(
            ax, ay, footX, footY, leg.L1, leg.L2, leg.dir
          );

          leg.dom.upper.setAttribute(
            "transform",
            `translate(${ax.toFixed(2)}, ${ay.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${upperDeg.toFixed(2)})`
          );
          leg.dom.lower.setAttribute(
            "transform",
            `translate(${jx.toFixed(2)}, ${jy.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${lowerDeg.toFixed(2)})`
          );
          leg.dom.hoof.setAttribute(
            "transform",
            `translate(${footX.toFixed(2)}, ${footY.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${hoofDeg.toFixed(2)})`
          );
        }

        // 5. Parallax Environment Scrolling
        const mtnFarX = -((elapsed * 4.5) % 1280);
        const mtnMidX = -((elapsed * 14) % 1280);
        const hillBackX = -((elapsed * 32) % 1280);
        mtnFarGroup.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${mtnFarX.toFixed(2)}, 0)`);
        mtnMidGroup.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${mtnMidX.toFixed(2)}, 0)`);
        hillBackLayer.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${hillBackX.toFixed(2)}, 0)`);

        // Clouds
        for (let i = 0; i < clouds.length; i++) {
          const c = clouds[i];
          c.x -= c.speed * dt;
          if (c.x < -160) c.x = 1440;
          c.node.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${c.x.toFixed(2)}, ${c.y}) scale(${c.scale})`);
        }

        // Mid-ground grass tufts
        for (let i = 0; i < backTufts.length; i++) {
          const t = backTufts[i];
          t.x -= groundSpeed * 0.72 * dt;
          if (t.x < -70) t.x += 1420;
          const sway = Math.sin(elapsed * 1.9 + t.phase) * 2.4;
          t.node.setAttribute(
            "transform",
            `translate(${t.x.toFixed(2)}, ${t.y.toFixed(1)}) scale(${t.scale.toFixed(2)}) skewX(${sway.toFixed(2)})`
          );
        }

        // Ground trail pebbles/specks (EXACT foot-lock speed!)
        for (let i = 0; i < trailDetails.length; i++) {
          const d = trailDetails[i];
          d.x -= groundSpeed * dt;
          if (d.x < -60) d.x += 1400;
          d.node.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${d.x.toFixed(2)}, ${d.y.toFixed(1)})`);
        }

        // Foreground grass & wildflowers
        for (let i = 0; i < frontItems.length; i++) {
          const f = frontItems[i];
          f.x -= groundSpeed * 1.32 * dt;
          if (f.x < -100) f.x += 1480;
          const sway = Math.sin(elapsed * 2.2 + f.phase) * f.swayAmp;
          f.node.setAttribute(
            "transform",
            `translate(${f.x.toFixed(2)}, ${f.y.toFixed(1)}) skewX(${sway.toFixed(2)})`
          );
        }

        // Sunlit pollen motes
        for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
          const m = motes[i];
          m.x += m.vx * dt;
          m.y += (m.vy + Math.sin(elapsed * 1.4 + m.phase) * 4) * dt;
          if (m.x < -20) m.x = 1300;
          if (m.y < 100) m.y = 620;
          const twinkle = m.baseOp * (0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(elapsed * 2.6 + m.phase));
          m.node.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${m.x.toFixed(2)}, ${m.y.toFixed(2)})`);
          m.node.setAttribute("opacity", twinkle.toFixed(2));
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
